body_markdown:
If you like random art, I've just released a new tool for generating random rings and dots (in `<svg>`).

With the editor, you can tweak a lot of parameters (Click the “Random!”-button to get started):

![Editor](assets/701816/651e542b.png)

And render art like these examples: 

![image1](assets/701816/a4f0b674.png)

![image2](assets/701816/6f4e54db.png)

![image3](assets/701816/6b457b77.png)
 
![image4](assets/701816/04de228f.png)

When you've made a piece you'd like to save, click on “Export", chose a file format, then click on “Save to Image”.

It's on Codepen (open fullscreen for best experience):

{% codepen https://codepen.io/stoumann/pen/dyvprJM %}

Thanks for reading!
